# Lincoln Memorial University

> Lincoln Memorial University (LMU) is a comprehensive regional university in Harrogate, Tennessee, offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs with deep historical roots connected to Abraham Lincoln and Appalachian heritage.

LMU serves students across traditional and online programs while maintaining a strong commitment to community engagement and preserving Civil War and Lincoln history through its renowned Abraham Lincoln Library and Museum. The university is located in the Cumberland Gap region of Eastern Tennessee and serves the broader Appalachian community.

- [Visit LMU](https://www.lmunet.edu/about-lmu/visit-lmu.php): Visitor information, directions, lodging, and prospective student admissions details
- [Campus Tour](https://www.lmunet.edu/about-lmu/campus-tour.php): Campus tour scheduling and virtual tour of LMU facilities in Harrogate
